parsed.rationale: VERSION_B drops the ice_queue_set_napi(..., NULL) calls that VERSION_A performs for each TX/RX ring before freeing the q_vector. This leaves the per-queue napi association pointing at a q_vector that is about to be kfree'd (line 38), so a later netif_napi_del / napi_schedule path could dereference freed memory (use-after-free). VERSION_A correctly clears the napi binding first.

semantic_changes.summary: VERSION_A checks `samples_per_pixel > MaxPixelChannels` early (right after reading header fields, before any pixel/quantum processing); VERSION_B removes that early check and instead performs the same check later, after SetImageAlphaChannel and before method selection.

parsed.rationale: Both revisions perform the MaxPixelChannels check, but VERSION_B defers it until after quantum_info is allocated and SetImageAlphaChannel/alpha-trait logic (which iterates extra_samples and touches sample_info) has already run. In VERSION_A the check occurs immediately after header parsing, before any channel-dependent processing, so an over-large samples_per_pixel is rejected before it can influence quantum_type/pad computations or alpha handling. The delayed check in B widens the window in which an out-of-range samples_per_pixel can affect earlier logic, making B the weaker revision.
